description.p: Skidbladnir converts images to WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL and HEIC. For a still image it offers every option of the official command-line encoders, each as a control labelled with the flag it sets, and writes the same bytes those tools write, apart from a few documented cases.

ul.li: WebP with every cwebp option, and animated WebP from animated WebP or GIF
AVIF with every avifenc option (libaom), JPEG XL with every cjxl option
HEIC, the format iPhones use, with heif-enc's options
Reads PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, HEIC, GIF, PNM, PFM, PGX, Y4M and SVG
Keeps colour profiles and metadata the way each tool does
Previews the result beside the original before anything is written
Converts whole folders, with progress per file and a Cancel that leaves no half-written image

description.p: This is the GPL edition, which writes HEIC with x265 and adds its lossless, 4:4:4, 4:2:2 and 10-bit output and tuning controls.
